```{r}
# Studi Kasus 3: ECM Konsumsi Rumah Tangga dan PDB
# Muhammad Hafidz Ar Rasyid Hutagalung
# 222413683
# 2KS3

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tseries)
library(urca)
library(lmtest)
library(broom)
library(zoo)


data <- read_excel("D:/Tugas/S4/ARW/soalUASno3.xlsx")

head(data)
str(data)

# Tanda "-" diubah menjadi NA
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    konsum = as.numeric(ifelse(konsum == "-", NA, konsum)),
    pdb    = as.numeric(ifelse(pdb == "-", NA, pdb))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(konsum),
    !is.na(pdb)
  )

# Cek jumlah observasi
nrow(data)

# Cek periode
head(data)
tail(data)


# Transformasi log
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    lcons = log(konsum),
    lpdb  = log(pdb)
  )
summary(data)

# Visualisasi
ggplot(data, aes(x = q, y = lcons, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Log Konsumsi Rumah Tangga",
    x = "Periode",
    y = "ln(Konsumsi)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))


ggplot(data, aes(x = q, y = lpdb, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Log PDB",
    x = "Periode",
    y = "ln(PDB)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))


# Uji AF
library(urca)
# Level
adf_lcons_none <- ur.df(
  data$lcons,
  type = "none",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

adf_lcons_drift <- ur.df(
  data$lcons,
  type = "drift",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

adf_lcons_trend <- ur.df(
  data$lcons,
  type = "trend",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

adf_lpdb_none <- ur.df(
  data$lpdb,
  type = "none",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

adf_lpdb_drift <- ur.df(
  data$lpdb,
  type = "drift",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

adf_lpdb_trend <- ur.df(
  data$lpdb,
  type = "trend",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

summary(adf_lcons_none)
summary(adf_lpdb_none)
summary(adf_lcons_drift)
summary(adf_lpdb_drift)
summary(adf_lcons_trend)
summary(adf_lpdb_drift)


# First Diff
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    dlcons = c(NA, diff(lcons)),
    dlpdb  = c(NA, diff(lpdb))
  )

# Cek apakah kolom sudah terbentuk
names(data)

# Lihat beberapa baris
head(data)

adf_dlcons_none <- ur.df(
  na.omit(data$dlcons),
  type = "none",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

adf_dlpdb_none <- ur.df(
  na.omit(data$dlpdb),
  type = "none",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

adf_dlcons_drift <- ur.df(
  na.omit(data$dlcons),
  type = "drift",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

adf_dlpdb_drift <- ur.df(
  na.omit(data$dlpdb),
  type = "drift",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

adf_dlcons_trend <- ur.df(
  na.omit(data$dlcons),
  type = "trend",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

adf_dlpdb_trend<- ur.df(
  na.omit(data$dlpdb),
  type = "trend",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

summary(adf_dlcons_none)
summary(adf_dlpdb_none)
summary(adf_dlcons_drift)
summary(adf_dlpdb_drift)
summary(adf_dlcons_trend)
summary(adf_dlpdb_trend)


# Regresi Jangka Panjang
long_run <- lm(
  lcons ~ lpdb,
  data = data
)

summary(long_run)

# Tabel koefisien
tidy(long_run)


# Bentuk Residual Jangka Panjang
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    ect = residuals(long_run)
  )


# Uji Kointegrasi Engle-Granger

# Residual persamaan kointegrasi diuji tanpa konstanta
# karena konstanta sudah terdapat pada persamaan jangka panjang.

eg_test <- ur.df(
  na.omit(data$ect),
  type = "none",
  selectlags = "AIC"
)

summary(eg_test)


# Jika residual stasioner: -> terdapat kointegrasi


# Bentuk ECT(-1)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    ect_lag1 = lag(ect, 1)
  )


# Data ECM
ecm_data <- data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(dlcons),
    !is.na(dlpdb),
    !is.na(ect_lag1)
  )


# Estimasi ECM
ecm_model <- lm(
  dlcons ~ dlpdb + ect_lag1,
  data = ecm_data
)

summary(ecm_model)

# Tabel hasil ECM
tidy(ecm_model)


# Diagnostik Autokorelasi
bg_test <- bgtest(
  ecm_model,
  order = 1
)

bg_test


# Diagnostik Heterokedastitas
bp_test <- bptest(
  ecm_model
)

bp_test


# Diagnostik Normalitas
res_ecm <- residuals(ecm_model)

jb_test <- jarque.bera.test(
  res_ecm
)

jb_test


# Grafik Residual
plot(
  res_ecm,
  type = "l",
  main = "Residual Error Correction Model",
  xlab = "Observasi",
  ylab = "Residual"
)

abline(h = 0, lty = 2)


# Ringkasan Hasil

cat("ADF LEVEL\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(adf_lcons_none)
print(adf_lcons_drift)
print(adf_lcons_trend)

print(adf_lpdb_none)
print(adf_lpdb_drift)
print(adf_lpdb_trend)


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("ADF FIRST DIFFERENCE\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(adf_dlcons_none)
print(adf_dlcons_drift)
print(adf_dlcons_trend)

print(adf_dlpdb_none)
print(adf_dlpdb_drift)
print(adf_dlpdb_trend)


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("REGRESI JANGKA PANJANG\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(summary(long_run))


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("ENGLE-GRANGER RESIDUAL TEST\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(summary(eg_test))


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("ERROR CORRECTION MODEL\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(summary(ecm_model))


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("DIAGNOSTIK\n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat("\nBreusch-Godfrey:\n")
print(bg_test)

cat("\nBreusch-Pagan:\n")
print(bp_test)

cat("\nJarque-Bera:\n")
print(jb_test)
```
